inapplicable.description: Each accesskey value must be unique.
inapplicable.help: Give every element that has an accesskey its own key.

inapplicable.description: An area element of an image map that is a link must have alternative text.
inapplicable.help: Add an alt attribute to the area that says where the link goes.

inapplicable.description: Each WAI-ARIA state or property on an element must be one that the element's role supports.
inapplicable.help: Remove the attribute, or give the element the role that supports it.

inapplicable.description: The role attribute of an element should be one that ARIA in HTML allows on that element.
inapplicable.help: Remove the role, or use an element that suits the role.

inapplicable.description: aria-braillelabel needs an accessible name and aria-brailleroledescription needs an aria-roledescription to refine.
inapplicable.help: Add the ordinary label or role description that the braille text abbreviates.

inapplicable.description: A button, link or menu item given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Give the control a visible text label, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A native checkbox must not carry an aria-checked value that disagrees with its checked state.
inapplicable.help: Drop aria-checked and let the checked attribute carry the state.

inapplicable.description: The role that applies to an element must not be one that WAI-ARIA or its digital publishing module has deprecated.
inapplicable.help: Replace the deprecated role with the role the specification recommends in its place.

inapplicable.description: A dialog or alert dialog given its role by the role attribute should have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Name the dialog with aria-labelledby pointing at its title, or with aria-label.

inapplicable.description: An element with aria-hidden="true" must not contain anything that can receive focus through the Tab key.
inapplicable.help: Make the hidden content non-focusable (tabindex="-1" or disabled), or stop hiding it.

inapplicable.description: A combo box, list box, search box, slider, spin button or text box given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Label the field with a visible label, aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A meter given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Say what the meter measures with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A progress bar given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Say what is progressing with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A WAI-ARIA attribute must not be used on a role that prohibits it, such as aria-label on an element with no role.
inapplicable.help: Remove the attribute, or give the element a role that can be named.

inapplicable.description: An element with an explicit role must set the states and properties that role requires.
inapplicable.help: Add the required attribute with a value that matches the element's state.

inapplicable.description: An element whose role needs owned elements (a list needs items, a table needs rows) must contain them.
inapplicable.help: Add the required child elements, or use a role that needs none.

inapplicable.description: An element whose role needs a parent role (a list item needs a list, a tab needs a tab list) must be inside one.
inapplicable.help: Put the element inside an element with the required role, or use a role that needs no parent.

inapplicable.description: A role attribute must contain at least one token that names a WAI-ARIA role authors may use.
inapplicable.help: Correct the role name, or remove the attribute and use an element that already has the meaning.

inapplicable.description: A tab given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Give the tab text, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: An element with role="text" must not contain focusable elements.
inapplicable.help: Move the focusable element out of the role="text" element, or remove the role.

inapplicable.description: A checkbox, radio button, switch, option or toggling menu item given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Label the control with text, aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A tooltip given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Give the tooltip text content, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A tree item given its role by the role attribute should have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Give the tree item text, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: Every attribute that starts with aria- must be a state or property defined by WAI-ARIA.
inapplicable.help: Fix the spelling of the attribute, or remove it if WAI-ARIA has no such state or property.

inapplicable.description: Every non-empty WAI-ARIA state or property must have a value of its type, and a required ID reference must name an element in the page.
inapplicable.help: Use one of the values WAI-ARIA allows for the attribute, or point the required reference at an element that exists.

inapplicable.description: The autocomplete attribute of a form field must follow the HTML autofill token syntax.
inapplicable.help: Change the autocomplete value to the field name that matches the data the field collects, such as email or street-address, optionally preceded by section-*, shipping or billing, and a contact type for telephone and e-mail fields.

inapplicable.description: The blink element makes text flash, which WCAG forbids for more than five seconds.
inapplicable.help: Remove the blink element and mark emphasis another way.

inapplicable.description: A dl may only directly contain well-ordered dt and dd groups, div, script and template elements.
inapplicable.help: Order the terms and descriptions as dt then dd, and move other content out of the dl.

inapplicable.description: A dt or dd element must be inside a dl.
inapplicable.help: Put the dt and dd elements in a dl.

inapplicable.description: An id value should be used by one element only.
inapplicable.help: Give each element its own id.

inapplicable.description: A focusable element must not share its id with another element.
inapplicable.help: Give each focusable element its own id.

inapplicable.description: An id that a label or an ARIA attribute refers to must be used by one element only.
inapplicable.help: Give each element its own id and keep the reference pointing at the right one.

inapplicable.description: The language named by a lang attribute should be the language of the text it covers.
inapplicable.help: Read the passage and make its lang attribute name the language the text is written in.

inapplicable.description: A heading must have text.
inapplicable.help: Put text in the heading, or remove the heading element if it is only for spacing.

inapplicable.description: A table header cell should have text a screen reader can read.
inapplicable.help: Put text in the header cell, or make it a data cell if it does not head anything.

inapplicable.description: An element made focusable with tabindex should have a role that says what it is.
inapplicable.help: Give the element a widget, landmark or dialog role, or take it out of the tab order.

inapplicable.description: A form field should not have more than one label element.
inapplicable.help: Use one label element for the field and put the extra text inside it.

inapplicable.description: A frame removed from the tab order must not contain focusable content.
inapplicable.help: Remove the negative tabindex from the frame, or remove the focusable content.

inapplicable.description: A frame or iframe must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Add a title attribute to the frame that says what it contains.

inapplicable.description: Frames with the same accessible name must have the same purpose.
inapplicable.help: Give each frame a name that says what it holds, or show the same resource in frames that share a name.

inapplicable.description: A heading should describe the topic or purpose of the section it introduces.
inapplicable.help: Reword the heading so that it says what the section is about.

inapplicable.description: Heading levels should only increase by one.
inapplicable.help: Change the heading's level so it is at most one deeper than the heading before it.

inapplicable.description: Content hidden with CSS should be checked: confirm that it is meant to be hidden.
inapplicable.help: Confirm the content is not needed by anyone, or show it.

inapplicable.description: When the html element has both lang and xml:lang, their primary languages must be the same.
inapplicable.help: Make the xml:lang attribute of the html element name the same language as lang, or remove xml:lang.

inapplicable.description: Links with the same name in the same context should serve the same purpose.
inapplicable.help: Give links that go to different places different names, or send the identical names in one context to the same resource.

inapplicable.description: Links with the same accessible name should serve the same purpose.
inapplicable.help: Give links that go to different places different names, or send the identical names to the same resource.

inapplicable.description: An img element must have alternative text, or be marked as decorative with an empty alt.
inapplicable.help: Add an alt attribute that says what the image shows, or alt="" if it is decorative.

inapplicable.description: A picture that is left out of the accessibility tree must be purely decorative.
inapplicable.help: Give the picture alternative text if it carries information, or keep it hidden if it is only decoration.

inapplicable.description: The accessible name of an image should describe it.
inapplicable.help: Reword the name so that it says what the image shows or does.

inapplicable.description: The alternative text of an image should not repeat the text next to it in a link or button.
inapplicable.help: Give the image an empty alt when the surrounding text already says it, or word the alt differently.

inapplicable.description: An input button must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Give the input a value attribute, or an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: An image button must have alternative text that says what it does.
inapplicable.help: Add an alt attribute to the image button that describes its action.

inapplicable.description: A form field must have a label.
inapplicable.help: Associate a visible label element with the field, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: The accessible name of a control must contain the text visible on it.
inapplicable.help: Start or include the visible text in the aria-label or aria-labelledby that names the control.

inapplicable.description: The visible label of a form field should describe its purpose.
inapplicable.help: Reword the label so that it says what to enter or choose.

inapplicable.description: A form field should have a visible label, not only a title attribute or a description.
inapplicable.help: Add a visible label element for the field, or name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A banner landmark must not sit inside another landmark.
inapplicable.help: Move the banner out of the other landmark, or give the inner element a role that is not banner.

inapplicable.description: A complementary landmark (an aside) should not sit inside another landmark.
inapplicable.help: Move the aside out of the other landmark, or give it a role that is not complementary.

inapplicable.description: A contentinfo landmark (a page footer) must not sit inside another landmark.
inapplicable.help: Move the footer out of the other landmark, or give the inner element a role that is not contentinfo.

inapplicable.description: A main landmark must not sit inside another landmark.
inapplicable.help: Move the main element out of the other landmark.

inapplicable.description: A page should have at most one banner landmark.
inapplicable.help: Keep one banner; give the other elements a role that is not banner, or use header inside sectioning content.

inapplicable.description: A page should have at most one contentinfo landmark.
inapplicable.help: Keep one page footer; give the other elements a role that is not contentinfo.

inapplicable.description: A page should have at most one main landmark.
inapplicable.help: Keep one main element; remove the role or element from the others.

inapplicable.description: Landmarks that share a role must have different accessible names.
inapplicable.help: Give each landmark of the same role a distinct aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A ul or ol may only directly contain li, script and template elements.
inapplicable.help: Move other elements and text into li elements, or out of the list.

inapplicable.description: An li element must be inside a ul, an ol or a list.
inapplicable.help: Put the li in a ul or ol, or give its parent the role list.

inapplicable.description: The marquee element scrolls text on its own, which a user must be able to stop.
inapplicable.help: Replace the marquee with static content, or with an animation a user can pause.

inapplicable.description: A page must not refresh or redirect on a timer, unless the delay is zero or longer than twenty hours.
inapplicable.help: Remove the timed refresh, redirect on the server, or add a way to turn it off.

inapplicable.description: A page must not refresh or redirect on a timer at all, other than immediately.
inapplicable.help: Remove the timed refresh and redirect on the server instead.

inapplicable.description: The viewport meta element must not stop a user from zooming in, or limit zoom below two times.
inapplicable.help: Remove user-scalable=no and any maximum-scale below 2 from the viewport content.

inapplicable.description: The viewport meta element should not cap zoom at less than five times.
inapplicable.help: Remove the maximum-scale cap, or raise it to 5 or more.

inapplicable.description: An object element that shows non-text content must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Name the object with aria-label, aria-labelledby or a title attribute.

inapplicable.description: An element marked as decorative must really be presentational: it may not be focusable or carry a global WAI-ARIA attribute.
inapplicable.help: Either make the element non-interactive without WAI-ARIA attributes, or drop the presentational role and give it a real one.

inapplicable.description: An element given the img role must have a text alternative.
inapplicable.help: Add an aria-label or aria-labelledby that says what the element shows.

inapplicable.description: The scope attribute belongs on th elements and must be col, row, colgroup or rowgroup.
inapplicable.help: Use scope only on th elements, with the value col, row, colgroup or rowgroup.

inapplicable.description: A scrollable region must be reachable with the keyboard.
inapplicable.help: Give the region tabindex 0, or put a focusable element inside it.

inapplicable.description: A select element must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Associate a label element with the select, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: A server-side image map cannot be used with a keyboard.
inapplicable.help: Replace the server-side image map with a client-side map or plain links.

inapplicable.description: A link to a place on the same page must have a target that exists and is not hidden.
inapplicable.help: Point the link at the id of an element that is on the page, or remove the link.

inapplicable.description: The summary of a details element must have an accessible name.
inapplicable.help: Put text in the summary, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

inapplicable.description: An SVG element with an image role must have a text alternative.
inapplicable.help: Add a title child, aria-label or aria-labelledby that says what the graphic shows.

inapplicable.description: A tabindex above 0 should not be used.
inapplicable.help: Reorder the elements in the document and use tabindex 0 or -1.

inapplicable.description: A table's caption should not repeat the text of its summary attribute.
inapplicable.help: Make the caption name the table and use summary only for extra detail, or remove the obsolete summary attribute.

inapplicable.description: A data cell that spans the whole first row to title the table should be a caption element.
inapplicable.help: Move the text into a caption element as the first child of the table and remove the spanning cell.

inapplicable.description: Each cell with content in a data table of at least three rows and three columns must have a header cell.
inapplicable.help: Mark the heading cells with th (and scope where needed), or give the cell a headers attribute that lists its header cells.

inapplicable.description: Every id listed in a cell's headers attribute must belong to another cell of the same table.
inapplicable.help: Make each id in the headers attribute the id of a header or data cell in the same table, and do not list the cell's own id.

inapplicable.description: Every header cell of a table must have at least one cell that it is the header of.
inapplicable.help: Remove the header cell or the markup that cuts it off from its cells, or add the cells it describes.

inapplicable.description: A lang attribute on content inside the body must start with a registered language code.
inapplicable.help: Change the lang attribute to a language code from the IANA registry, such as es or zh-Hans.

passes.description: The body element must not have aria-hidden="true", which hides the whole page from assistive technology.
passes.help: Remove aria-hidden from body; hide only the parts of the page that need hiding.

passes.description: Audio or video that starts by itself with sound must have a way to pause, stop or silence it.
passes.help: Add the controls attribute, or put a visible, named pause or mute button on the page.

passes.description: A button element must have an accessible name.
passes.help: Put text in the button, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

passes.description: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 with its background (3:1 for large text).
passes.help: Change the text or background colour until the ratio reaches 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text.

passes.description: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 with its background (4.5:1 for large text).
passes.help: Change the text or background colour until the ratio reaches 7:1, or 4.5:1 for large text.

passes.description: The document must have a title element with text in it.
passes.help: Add a title element to the head of the document and say in it what the page is.

passes.description: An element that can be reached with the keyboard must show that it has focus.
passes.help: Do not remove the browser's focus outline without replacing it; give :focus-visible a visible outline, background or border change.

passes.description: The html element must have a lang attribute that is not empty.
passes.help: Add a lang attribute to the html element that names the main language of the page, such as lang="en".

passes.description: The lang attribute of the html element must start with a registered language code.
passes.help: Change the lang attribute of the html element to a language code from the IANA registry, such as en or fr-CA.

passes.description: A link must have an accessible name.
passes.help: Put text or an image with alternative text in the link, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

passes.description: An element whose role makes its children presentational (a button, a tab, an image) must not contain anything reachable with the Tab key.
passes.help: Move the focusable element out, or change the outer role to one that exposes its children.

passes.description: Audio or video that starts by itself and plays sound for more than three seconds must have a way to pause or silence it.
passes.help: Add the controls attribute, a pause button, or mute the media.

passes.description: A paragraph styled to look like a heading should be a real heading.
passes.help: Use a heading element (h1 to h6) for the text and style it with CSS.
